note: Animated Arena props. frames[] are 1-based Flash frames, each trimmed to its own content box: x/y locate it in the atlas, lx/ly place it against the symbol registration point that the Arena matrix positions. `stops` are frames the clip halts on (play() runs to the next); `loop` cycles; `randStart` seeds a random frame so copies are out of phase, and `randLoop` re-rolls it every time round. A placement's a/b/c/d are the authored transform's 2x2 — rotation and flips are both in use, so it is applied whole rather than decomposed. A `whitened` prop is a flat alpha mask: tint it with the placement's `tint`, or with the prop's `nativeTint` when the placement carries none.
